assays.assay_name: Intravenous Cocaine Self-Administration (acquisition, extinction, cue-induced reinstatement)
assays.assay_description: Operant chambers (40 × 30 × 52 cm) with two levers on FR1 schedule; 2-h daily sessions. Acquisition with cocaine dose escalation (0.25 → 0.5 mg/kg/infusion), 10 days of extinction (saline, no cues; psilocybin or ibogaine administered on extinction days 1 and 5), and a single cue-induced reinstatement test 6 days after the last treatment.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin ... administered subcutaneously (s.c.) ... Ibogaine ... for intraperitoneal administration (i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were trained to press the active lever on a fixed ratio 1 (FR1) schedule ... [sucrose pellet training prior to cocaine sessions]

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed daily into standard operant conditioning chambers

food_restriction.evidence: water and food were provided ad libitum [in the home cage]; no food present in chamber during cocaine/extinction sessions

water_restriction.evidence: water and food were provided ad libitum [in the home cage]; no water present in chamber during sessions

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocybin or ibogaine was administered ... on extinction days 1 and 5 ... ensuring an interval of ~24 h before the subsequent extinction session ... A cue-induced reinstatement test was conducted 6 days after the last treatment

sample_size.evidence: For each of the two studies (psilocybin/ibogaine), adult male Wistar rats ( n = 40 ...)

outcomes.summary: Both psilocybin (1.25 → 5 mg/kg) and ibogaine (10 → 40 mg/kg) reduced active lever pressing/cocaine infusions during extinction; psilocybin reached significance 1 day after the second dose (with trend after first), ibogaine was significant after both doses. Both compounds also reduced between-subject variance. Neither compound significantly altered cue-induced reinstatement, though psilocybin showed a non-significant trend toward attenuation.
outcomes.statistics: Extinction psilocybin: t(28)=2.36, p=0.026 (day 6); t(28)=1.32, p=0.098 (day 2). Extinction ibogaine: t(22)=2.59, p=0.016 (day 6); t(22)=1.73, p=0.049 (day 2). Reinstatement psilocybin: t(28)=0.83, p=0.20; ibogaine: t(22)=-0.14, p=0.56.
outcomes.evidence: Rats receiving psilocybin showed a marked reduction in infusion intake 1 day after the second treatment ... ibogaine ... significant decrease ... Administration of either psilocybin or ibogaine did not produce a statistically significant effect on reward intake during cue-induced reinstatement

E6_spatial.evidence: operant chamber is a single compartment

E7_social_context.evidence: Only the focal animal present in the operant chamber

D5_followup.evidence: A cue-induced reinstatement test was conducted 6 days after the last treatment

assays.assay_description: 80 × 80 cm black arena with 70-cm walls; rats placed in centre and allowed free exploration for 15 min under dim lighting (60 lx). Five OFTs conducted (baseline + pre/post each treatment). Behaviour recorded at 25 fps and analysed using DeepLabCut for trajectory length, time in centre, and thigmotaxis.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin administered s.c.; ibogaine administered i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the OFT arena described

setup_restrain.evidence: A rat was allowed to move freely within the arena for 15 min

food_restriction.evidence: empty black arena (80 × 80 cm); no food present during 15-min test

water_restriction.evidence: empty black arena; no water in arena during test

time_to_assay.evidence: OFTs were conducted ... prior to IVSA (baseline), right before the psychedelic or saline administration (pre-I and II), and ~24 h after psychedelic or saline administration (post-I and II)

sample_size.evidence: adult male Wistar rats ( n = 40) for each study

outcomes.summary: Neither psilocybin nor ibogaine produced significant effects on locomotor or anxiety-like behaviour (trajectory length, time in centre, thigmotaxis) before or 24 h after treatment, with one exception: ibogaine-treated rats spent significantly more time in the centre after the second dose, which the authors attributed to a technical obstruction.
outcomes.statistics: Baseline psilocybin: trajectory t(24)=-0.24, p=1.00; centre time t(24)=-0.47, p=1.00; thigmotaxis t(24)=-0.77, p=1.00. Post-2nd psilocybin: trajectory t(12)=1.50, p=0.91; centre t(12)=0.31, p=1.00; thigmotaxis t(12)=0.16, p=1.00. Post-2nd ibogaine: centre time t(26)=4.10, p=0.01; trajectory t(26)=2.31, p=0.32; thigmotaxis t(26)=2.55, p=0.21.
outcomes.evidence: The applied treatment had no side effects on general locomotor activity or anxiety-like behaviour, as measured in the open field test 24 h after each administration

B1_num_measures.evidence: trajectory length, time spent moving in the centre, thigmotaxis

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total values reported per 15-min session; no within-session time-course

B6_cognitive.evidence: OFT assesses innate exploration/anxiety, not learning

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Videos were analysed using DeepLabCut software (DLC) ... key points: nose, neck and tail root

B8_multivariate.evidence: Separate univariate t-tests reported per measure

E1_environment_type.evidence: empty black arena (80 × 80 cm) surrounded by 70 cm high walls

E6_spatial.evidence: single open arena; the 25-square grid is a virtual analysis grid

E7_social_context.evidence: rat placed in the central part ... allowed to move freely

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in arena

D1_continuity.evidence: A total of five OFTs were conducted

D2_session_duration.evidence: A rat was allowed to move freely within the arena for 15 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: five OFTs (baseline + pre-I, post-I, pre-II, post-II)

D4_baseline.evidence: one baseline assessment before the start of the IVSA protocol

D5_followup.evidence: ~24 h after psychedelic or saline administration (post-I and II)

judge_notes: Merged glm's separate 'IVSA-Extinction' and 'Cue-Induced Reinstatement' assays into one IVSA assay per rubric guidance (acquisition + extinction + reinstatement are phases of the same operant paradigm).
D2 for IVSA scored 2 (61 min–6 h) because daily sessions were 2 h; glm's score of 1 was a misclassification.
B1 scored 1 (2-3 measures: active lever, inactive lever, infusions) — not 2 as in glm (which used the 4-6 bin).
Sex n_male reported as 80 total across both studies (40 + 40); each individual study used 40 male rats.
day_night_flipped kept as not_reported because the paper only states '12/12 h light/dark cycle' without specifying direction.
OFT setup_habituation set to not_reported — paper does not describe pre-test apparatus exposure (gptoss interpretation preferred over glm 'no').
